command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== MethylDackel extract on the SAME alignments Bismark produced =="
MethylDackel extract --mergeContext chrS.fa sorted.bam -o md > md.log 2>&1
grep -v '^track' md_CpG.bedGraph | sort -k2,2n > md_raw.txt
cat md_raw.txt

# COORDINATE NORMALISATION: MethylDackel's --mergeContext bedGraph is 0-based half-open over the
# CpG (start=199 for the C at 1-based 200); Bismark's .cov is the 1-based C position. Compare
# counts only after aligning the conventions, or two agreeing tools look like they disagree.
awk '{printf "%s\t%d\t%d\t%d\n", $1, $2+1, $5, $6}' md_raw.txt | sort -k2,2n > md_calls.tsv

echo "--- truth / bismark / methyldackel (chrom pos nMeth nUnmeth) ---"
paste truth.tsv bismark_calls.tsv md_calls.tsv | sed 's/\t/  /g'

MD_SITES=$(wc -l < md_calls.tsv | tr -d ' ')
MD_EXACT=no; cmp -s truth.tsv md_calls.tsv && MD_EXACT=yes
BM_EXACT=no; cmp -s truth.tsv bismark_calls.tsv && BM_EXACT=yes
AGREE=no;    cmp -s bismark_calls.tsv md_calls.tsv && AGREE=yes
MD_CALLS=$(awk '{s+=$3+$4} END{print s+0}' md_calls.tsv)
READS=$(awk '/reads/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="reads") print $(i+1)}' fixture.txt)
RAW_MATCH=no; cmp -s <(cut -f1,2 truth.tsv) <(cut -f1,2 md_raw.txt) && RAW_MATCH=yes

{
  echo "Methylation -- two independent callers on one set of bisulfite alignments"
  echo "methyldackel_version  $(MethylDackel --version 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $1}')"
  echo "sites_methyldackel    $MD_SITES   (assert 3)"
  echo "bismark_exact         $BM_EXACT   (assert yes -- EXACT vs planted truth)"
  echo "methyldackel_exact    $MD_EXACT   (assert yes -- EXACT vs planted truth)"
  echo "callers_agree         $AGREE   (assert yes -- cross-validation on identical alignments)"
  echo "methyldackel_calls    $MD_CALLS of $READS reads   (assert equal -- CONSERVATION)"
  echo "raw_coords_match      $RAW_MATCH   (expect NO: MethylDackel is 0-based half-open over the CpG, Bismark is the 1-based C)"
  echo "note  the two callers agree on every count; only the COORDINATE CONVENTION differs, so a naive diff would report a disagreement that does not exist"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$MD_SITES" -eq 3
test "$BM_EXACT" = yes
test "$MD_EXACT" = yes
test "$AGREE" = yes
test "$MD_CALLS" -eq "$READS"
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
